turns: I’m transcribing the downhill day from Annapurna Base Camp to Bamboo on the KeiTreks trip. My sheet accepts whole minutes only. What goes in the elapsed column?

turns: I can train with the pack I'll actually take. Besides kilometres, what parts of a practice outing would make it more like my route?

turns: I'm quicker than the rest of my group on stairs. Can I infer from that alone that I won't develop altitude illness at ABC?
key: No; fitness/speed alone does not rule out altitude illness. No personal clearance.
